snippet.title: 'Crayon Shinchan: My Sugoroku Great Strategy' Official Service Launch!
snippet.description:
The game "Crayon Shinchan: My Sugoroku Great Strategy" has officially launched on the G123 game service! Enjoy an easy-to-play sugoroku game with just one finger! Fully enjoy a rich and diverse collection of features! 

Start playing here: https://s.g123.jp/7as4bsg4

This title is an HTML5 game that can be enjoyed on the web browser of your smartphone, tablet, or PC. It also features a robust idle function, allowing you to play in various styles—take your time at home on your PC or play quickly on your smartphone while out and about.

■ Basic Game Info
Game Title: Crayon Shinchan: My Sugoroku Great Strategy
Genre: Sugoroku Game
Price: Free (with in-game item purchases)
Supported Languages (planned): Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Korean

#CrayonShinchan #Kureshin #Shinchan #G123 #FreeGame #NewGame
